data.narrative:
Fire Point is a Series A defense and security company founded by Denys Shtilerman, Iryna Terekh, and Yehor Skalyha, with the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense as an anchor investor. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

The peer-median method anchors the analysis. The 11-company median valuation is $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. Sampled comparables at Series B stage include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B), reflecting the heterogeneity within the defense tech sector at advanced stages.

A triangulated valuation range of $850M to $1.1B (median $1.0B) is supported by the peer-median method. The relatively narrow implied range reflects the concentration of private peers around the $1.0B mark at Series B. Key uncertainties include Fire Point's revenue scale and customer concentration relative to peers—data not available in this analysis—and the degree to which Ukrainian government backing and geopolitical exposure warrant stage or sector discounts. Additional revenue and growth metrics would strengthen conviction in the range.
